edges.reason: freeRollMint reads freeRollPunks[msg.sender] to determine mintable rolls and mints to the caller.
mint uses msg.sender for the refund transfer and as mint recipient.
_mint uses msg.sender as the recipient of _safeMint.
block.timestamp is part of the randomness entropy, creating timestamp dependency.
useRandomAvailableToken returns the derived token id to the _mint loop.
useRandomAvailableToken delegates selection to useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
_mint indirectly mutates the _availableTokens swap array via token selection.
_mint decrements _numAvailableTokens and writes it back.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex reads and rewrites _availableTokens entries.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex computes lastIndex from _numAvailableTokens - 1 and decrements it.
mint multiplies _price by _numToMint to compute the required cost.
setPrice writes the new value into _price.
startSale sets isSaleOn to true.
endSale sets isSaleOn to false.
giveFreeRoll adds numRolls to freeRollPunks[receiver].
withdrawTeam sends the _oaf share to the hardcoded oaf address.
withdrawTeam sends the remaining _quack share to the hardcoded quack address.
_numToMint parameter drives mint cost and supply checks.
_numToMint is forwarded from mint into the internal _mint loop.
receiver parameter indexes the freeRollPunks mapping.
numRolls parameter is added into freeRollPunks and _numFreeRollsGiven.
indexToUse parameter selects the entry mutated in _availableTokens.
_newPrice parameter is stored into the _price state variable.
mint invokes the internal _mint after validating payment.
freeRollMint invokes the internal _mint for the owed quantity.
_mint loop calls useRandomAvailableToken each iteration.
withdrawFailsafe forwards all balance to msg.sender via call, enabling reentrancy on the caller.
The low-level call in withdrawFailsafe transfers control to msg.sender.
useRandomAvailableToken realizes the weak randomness unsafe operation.
withdrawTeam realizes the low-level send unsafe operation.
withdrawFailsafe realizes the low-level call unsafe operation.
msg.sender is included in the randomness entropy, allowing caller influence.
freeRollPunks is keyed by msg.sender in freeRollMint and giveFreeRoll-related views.

normalization_plan.reason: The _numToMint parameter only carries caller input into mint and its internal mint loop.
The receiver parameter is only used as the mapping key inside giveFreeRoll.
The numRolls parameter is only consumed by giveFreeRoll arithmetic.
The indexToUse parameter is only used to select the swap entry in useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
The _newPrice parameter is only stored into _price by setPrice.
